title: OpenAI responds to Apple's lawsuit over alleged trade secret theft
summary: Apple accuses OpenAI of hiring former employees who took confidential data; OpenAI publishes chats to rebut the accusations.

title: Sandisk and SK hynix present the first HBF memory specification for GPUs
summary: The new high-bandwidth NAND memory aims to give GPUs and CPUs up to 512 GB additional with 3 TB/s.

title: Shortage drives up RTX 50 GPU prices in Asia as NVIDIA prepares Blackwell Ultra
summary: Gigabyte card prices rise between 20% and 40% in Japan and RTX 50s become 30% more expensive in South Korea; the current generation is nearing its end.

title: AI spreads across Hollywood, the Pulitzer Prizes, and video game development
summary: A record number of Pulitzer winners admit to using AI, the audiovisual industry debates its adoption, and game creators defend themselves against accusations.

title: Anthropic signs a $10 billion deal for Volta cloud computing
summary: The AI company will secure capacity at a cloud provider that has been operational for less than six months.

title: HP, ASUS, and Acer use Chinese CXMT memory amid global RAM shortage
summary: CXMT starts production of LPDDR6 and its chips begin to appear in laptops destined for non-US markets.

title: Texas suspends connection of new data centers due to collapse of its power grid
summary: The governor orders audits while 1,800 requests accumulate 474 gigawatts, five times the current peak demand.

title: Waymo opens its robotaxi service to all passengers in Dallas
summary: The autonomous vehicle company expands its deployment in Texas without a waiting list.

title: Apple removes and restores Telegram on the App Store after review for child abuse content
summary: The app was temporarily blocked for alleged sexual exploitation material and then became available again.

title: A worm in npm poisons hundreds of packages through the Keyv library
summary: The Shai-Hulud attack compromises Node.js libraries and installs hooks in Claude Code and VS Code to steal credentials.

title: Autonomous AIs are already being used to hack systems, according to security analysts
summary: Reports warn that AI agents can be manipulated to execute attacks and overcome traditional defenses.

title: Steam confirms that the most used gaming PC has 8 cores and 16 GB of RAM
summary: The platform's hardware survey shows that players increasingly need more resources for current titles.

title: ASUS, GIGABYTE, and MSI will raise the price of their motherboards in the coming weeks
summary: The main motherboard manufacturers plan price increases in the third quarter of 2026.

title: Bazzite improves its support for NVIDIA GPUs with suspend and power fixes
summary: The Linux gaming distribution incorporates experimental patches that optimize performance on NVIDIA cards.
